summary: Triangle-pair intersection test. Computes edge half-planes of the first triangle into a 72-byte stack buffer, then for each of the three vertex pairs tests a separating axis via SATSeparatingAxisTest; if none separates, repeats the process on the second triangle against the first's vertex pairs. When neither triangle pair is separated, tests 2D line-segment intersections between the edges of both triangles with F_2DLineSegmentIntersection; returns 1 (intersecting) on the first edge crossing, else 0.

operations.description: Compute edge half-plane data of the first triangle this into the stack buffer v13 via TriangleEdgeHalfPlaneComputation(this, v13).
Loop over the three vertex pairs of the second triangle a2: index v4 from 0, test SATSeparatingAxisTest(v13, a2[2*v4]).
Guard on each SATSeparatingAxisTest result: a true separating axis returns 1 immediately; exit the loop when all three tests pass without separation (v4 reaches 3).
Recompute edge half-planes of the second triangle a2 into the same buffer via TriangleEdgeHalfPlaneComputation(a2, v13).
Loop over the three vertex pairs of the first triangle this: index v5 from 0, test SATSeparatingAxisTest(v13, this[2*v5]); return 1 if any test reports a separating axis.

Nested edge-pair loop: for edge index v6 in 0..2, compute next vertex index v7 = (v6 + 1) % 3, then iterate over the second triangle's vertices v11 = 0..2 calling F_2DLineSegmentIntersection(this[2*v6], this[2*v7], a2[2*v6], a2[2*v9]).
Return 1 when any edge pair intersects; return 0 when all three edge-pair scans complete without an intersection.
